title: The SS never surrendered

tellings.quote: The SS is not included in the German instruments of surrender.

plain: The SS, Hitler's elite force, never formally surrendered in 1945, according to a researcher named Jason Jorjani, who says on the show that "the SS is not included in the German instruments of surrender," the documents by which Germany gave up at the end of the war. His point, made in an episode about a secret Nazi UFO programme, is that a part of the Nazi state may have kept going after the war. Whether a surrender of Germany's forces covered the SS without naming it, he does not say.
